$comment: One declaration of PR composition inputs (HA#171, HA#351). Reader ids, templates, titles, families and defaults live in contracts/pr-sections.json. Readers resolve a per-run requirements array; the checked default is process.canon. Gate and changelog path sets remain solely here. scripts/pr_composition_check.sh refuses drift and copied path sets.

bodyRequirements.$comment: Derived from the catalogue, not a universal template. Runtime resolution uses the target kind, issue jobs and Mukai facts. This checked array is the process.canon default with a policy hit.

gateDerive.$comment: nen gate derive --policy-paths / --process-paths, keyed by the canon repository (owner/name) whose own canon the sets are. A consumer repository is G2 by role and the verb is not run (docs/WORKFLOW.md section Gate derivation, step 1); a canon repository with no row here has no declared sets, which the run states and asks for (docs/WORKFLOW.md section 4, Ask, set up, continue) and never improvises. Each value is passed comma-joined, in the order written. Both nen/ and schemas/ stay listed: a prefix is taken literally, and an un-migrated target still edits a real schemas/*.json. contracts/ and templates/ are in zheref/hatsu's process set so this declaration, the requirements array and the template derive G4 as WORKFLOW.md did when it held the sets -- confirmed by the maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-13 (docs/ROSTER.md section Rulings of 2026-10-13; zheref/hatsu#171).

changelogFragment.$comment: nen changelog fragment-required --spec-paths (comma-joined) --fragment-dir --head-changelog, every target; --head-changelog resolves against --repo. A pull request that changes a specPaths path owes a fragment under fragmentDir (CONTRIBUTING.md, Changelog fragments) and reads fragment-present with no opt-out. directSection is the one case that does not: a pull request that writes its own section into headChangelog, as futon's integration PR does (docs/ROSTER.md, Rulings of 2026-09-30 -- En never merges: the terminus carries the CHANGELOG). Its body carries `optOut` verbatim, and only when its own diff changes headChangelog. UNENFORCED BY NEN: the verb honours the phrase anywhere -- over any diff, inside an HTML comment or a code fence -- so a body carrying it over any other diff passes; a Hatsu-side raw-body check is owed (the nen half is zheref/nen#239's scope).

directSection.when: the pull request's own changed files include headChangelog
directSection.optOut: no CHANGELOG entry: this pull request writes its own CHANGELOG.md section (contracts/pr-composition.json, changelogFragment.directSection)
